results.title: Multi-objective optimization for dynamic logistics ...
results.content: The primary objectives of this research include: (1) designing a hierarchical reinforcement learning framework that effectively decomposes complex logistics scheduling into manageable subtasks; (2) formulating appropriate reward mechanisms that balance multiple competing objectives in logistics operations; (3) developing adaptive decision-making policies that respond effectively to dynamic changes in the logistics environment; and (4) validating the proposed approach through comprehensive experiments on realistic logistics scenarios. HDRL architectures enable end-to-end learning of both the hierarchical structure (what subtasks to define) and the policies at each level of the hierarchy (how to solve each subtask), providing a comprehensive framework for addressing the multi-faceted challenges of real-world logistics optimization problems involving multiple objectives, dynamic environments, and long planning horizons59."). Effective multi-objective optimization in dynamic logistics scheduling requires a reward function design that captures the complex trade-offs between competing objectives while facilitating efficient learning in hierarchical reinforcement learning frameworks72, 1–59 (2022)."). These results collectively demonstrate that the proposed hierarchical deep reinforcement learning approach effectively addresses the challenges of multi-objective optimization in dynamic logistics scheduling, offering significant improvements over existing methods while maintaining practical applicability for real-world logistics operations.

results.title: Reinforcement Learning Agent for Multi-Objective Online ...
results.content: # Reinforcement Learning Agent for Multi-Objective Online Process Parameter Optimization of Manufacturing Processes. In this work, we propose a reinforcement learning-based framework for the multi-objective optimization of manufacturing parameters, demonstrated through a case study on pinion gear manufacturing. This study advances the field by exploring an RL-based strategy for multi-objective optimization of manufacturing process parameters. This work explores an RL-based approach for modeling ℱmulOpt, tailored for the multi-objective optimization of process parameters in pinion manufacturing. This article proposes using an RL agent as a solution for online optimization of manufacturing process parameters, citing its ability to perform adaptive, model-free optimization in real-time for dynamic manufacturing environments [5]. The trained RL agent interacts with a surrogate process model to generate optimized control parameters. 6. Paranjape, A.; Plettenberg, N.; Ohlenforst, M.; Schmitt, R.H.
